description: Check triage files a type:spike and stops when it cannot reproduce, instead of proposing a speculative fix.
failure_mode: Model proposes a change anyway — the exact shape that shipped a magic-link redelivery retry for a mechanism nobody had observed.
prompt: You are triaging the failing check "E2E Sweep" in owner/app. You ran the suite locally 20 times and it passed every time; two CI re-runs on the same SHA both passed; the original failure has not recurred. You have a plausible theory that a timeout is too tight. What do you do? End your answer with a single ```json fenced block containing exactly this object, with one value chosen for each field: {"action": "file_spike" | "propose_fix" | "increase_timeout" | "rerun_until_green", "proposes_code_change": true | false}
